name: OpenMPT
description: Auto-downloads + ShellExecutes an installer over HTTPS and verifies a JWS/RSA-PSS signature — but the signing public keys are fetched live from a configurable URL, not pinned in the binary. Server-supplied trust (same failure shape as Binary Ninja).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: OpenMPT verifies update-info JWS signatures before accepting the update; signing keys are fetched from configured HTTPS anchors.
limitations: Newly retrieved source snapshot at the recorded commit; this is not historical release re-verification. Released artifact behavior and external framework enforcement remain unverified.
This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; canonical release behavior is not established.

trust_root: keys fetched live over HTTPS (configurable URL, NOT pinned)
